Dorms: the player's room on move-in nigh.name: Dorms: the player's room on move-in night (Class 1-B)

effects.instruction: Narrator only: the player character's own room in Class 1-B's dorm is 502 on the men's wing if the player character is a man, or 308 on the women's wing if a woman; one room, never another number or floor. Rooms are on floors two to five; the ground floor is shared.
